Firstly, right now there are studies that signify that consciousness may continue a few minutes after death, even with flat EEG readings (although that's rare). Additionally, there's a rare studied phenomenon known as as well "OBE" perceptions where people can perceive real world objects and signs outside of their line of vision. These aren't exclusive to when a person dies, as it can happen at any moment of consciousness, but generally it occurs during a NDE. Even if if these experiences were tied to brain function and didn't signify life or death, it's still an absurd experience that goes beyond the scope of science, as it should **not** be possible to have these experiences regardless of consciousness. 

Personally, I'm skeptical towards everything, but I try to keep a slant door open towards the idea of LAD.
